name: How Stair Refinishing Is Priced in Bellevue, and Why It's Per-Step
title-tag: Stair Refinishing Cost in Bellevue: Why It's Per-Tread
meta-description: Stair refinishing in Bellevue runs $55–$75 per tread. What the number covers, what a 13-step staircase really costs, and when new treads beat refinishing.
post-summary: September 16, 2026 · Stairs are priced per tread — $55–$75 — because no floor machine fits on a step; every tread is hand work. The math on a 13-tread Bellevue staircase, what carpet leaves behind, and when new treads beat refinishing.
